troubleshoot.title: Why is the preview blank or refusing to connect?
troubleshoot.subtitle: Modern web security prevents certain sites from being embedded inside frames. Here is what is happening and how to preview your site effortlessly:
troubleshoot.cause1Desc: Sites like google.com, github.com, and twitter.com send HTTP headers (X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self') that instruct the browser to disallow iframe embedding to prevent clickjacking.
troubleshoot.cause2Desc: Because ResponsiveViewer is hosted over secure HTTPS on GitHub Pages, loading an unencrypted http://localhost or http:// staging URL may trigger browser Mixed Content blocks.
troubleshoot.sol1Desc: Local development servers are 100% supported! Run your server with HTTPS (e.g., `vite --https` or `next dev --experimental-https`), or in Chrome visit `chrome://flags/#allow-insecure-localhost` to permit localhost embeds.
troubleshoot.sol2Desc: For testing third-party production URLs, install a lightweight browser extension such as 'Ignore X-Frame-Headers' or 'ModHeader' to temporarily bypass iframe restrictions in your private test session.
troubleshoot.sol3Title: Public Staging with Free HTTPS Tunnels
troubleshoot.sol3Desc: Instantly preview your local project on a secure public HTTPS endpoint using ngrok (`npx ngrok http 3000`) or Cloudflare Tunnel (`cloudflared tunnel`).

seo.title: ResponsiveViewer | Automated Multi-Device Web Responsiveness Tester
seo.description: Ultra-minimal, 100% client-side responsive web tester. Preview localhost and live sites across accurate mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports with automated Play cycling. Zero servers, zero tracking.
seo.keywords: responsive website viewer, test website on different screen sizes, localhost responsive tester, mobile viewport checker online, responsive design mode, device presentation mode
seo.heroTitle: Preview Any Website Across Every Screen Size Automatically
seo.heroSubtitle: Accurate mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports with a 1-click Auto-Play presentation mode, instant scale-to-fit, and zero server dependencies.
seo.featuresTitle: Engineered for Frontend Engineers & UI/UX Designers
seo.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to audit, debug, and showcase responsive web layouts without leaving your browser.
seo.f1Desc: Hit 'Play' to glide through your breakpoints automatically. Perfect for client walkthroughs, responsive QA testing, and design reviews at customizable 3s, 5s, or 8s intervals.
seo.f2Desc: Zero backend servers. Zero cookies. Zero telemetry tracking. All URLs and custom presets reside exclusively in your browser LocalStorage, keeping your localhost and staging builds confidential.
seo.f3Desc: Intelligent CSS 2D transform engine calculates the exact bounding box to fit 1920x1080 desktop screens or tall mobile devices seamlessly onto any developer display.
seo.f4Desc: Toggle realistic device bezels, Dynamic Island, and notch outlines to preview real-world viewport constraints, safe areas, and mobile navigation layouts.
seo.faq1Q: Can I test my local development server (e.g. localhost:3000)?
seo.faq1A: Yes! ResponsiveViewer runs entirely inside your client browser. It connects directly to your machine's localhost, 127.0.0.1, Docker containers, or internal staging IPs without sending any network traffic to an external server.
seo.faq2Q: Why do some live production websites show a blank screen?
seo.faq2A: Large corporate sites (such as Google or GitHub) specify X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or CSP frame-ancestors headers to guard against clickjacking. To test these sites, use an X-Frame-Options browser extension or test staging URLs where headers can be configured.
seo.faq3Q: How does the automated 'Play' mode work?
seo.faq3A: Click the Play button on the floating studio control bar. ResponsiveViewer will smoothly cycle through every device preset (iPhone, Galaxy, iPad, MacBook, Desktop) with an animated progress ring and fluid dimension transitions.
seo.faq4Q: Is ResponsiveViewer free and open source?
seo.faq4A: Yes, ResponsiveViewer is 100% free with zero ads and zero tracking. If it saves you time in your daily workflow, you can support ongoing development on Ko-fi!
